user.title: Lena
user.description: Adds Lena's feelings, her memory list and her tools. Afterwards, open Configure to tell her about your house, then tick Lena under Control Home Assistant in your Ollama conversation agent.

init.title: Lena
init.description: Who she misses, what she notices, her day, and who she tells when something's wrong. Her feelings' descriptions are in feelings.yaml in the integration's folder.

data.empty_hours: Lonely after the house is empty for
data.mood_change_chance: Chance per hour a mood moves on
data.alert_phones: Tell these phones when she's worried
data.alert_agent: Write alerts in her words with
data.alert_all_clear: Also tell them when it's sorted

data_description.people: Coming home after a while makes her delighted; an empty house makes her restless.
data_description.weather: Rain, storms, snow and sunshine colour her mood.
data_description.special_days: Birthdays, anniversaries or holidays: anything on these today puts her in a good mood.
data_description.worries: Problem sensors she frets about while they're on: leaks, smoke, a door or garage left open.
data_description.mood_change_chance: Once a mood has lasted long enough.
data_description.moment_minutes: How long a reaction, like being pleased or exasperated, lasts.
data_description.alert_phones: Phones with the Home Assistant companion app. Tapping the alert opens the Lena app, listening.
data_description.alert_agent: Your Lena conversation agent. She writes each alert herself; leave empty to send the plain reason instead.
data_description.alert_all_clear: A second alert when the sensor clears, replacing the first.
data_description.memory_tidy_days: She combines lines about the same thing, makes vague ones clear and ticks off outdated ones, at bedtime, then tells you what changed (Lena: Undo memory tidy puts it back). 0 never.
data_description.memory_tidy_task: An AI Task entity, such as your Ollama's. Empty: Home Assistant's default (Settings > System > General > AI suggestions).
data_description.local_weather: Your own weather sensors (an Ecowitt in the backyard: temperature, humidity, wind, rain). She uses them for what it's like outside right now, before any forecast service, in conversations and her morning briefing.

feel.name: Feel
feel.description: Sets how something just made Lena feel. It fades on its own after a few minutes.

moment.name: Moment
moment.description: One of her moments in feelings.yaml, for example Pleased or Exasperated.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What happened, in a few words, written to her.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Adds an event to a calendar exposed to Assist, the way Lena does when asked. Open WebUI's Lena tool uses it.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: The calendar's name as shown in Home Assistant. Can be left out when only one calendar can take events.

start.name: Start
start.description: A date (2026-11-14) for an all-day event, or a date and time (2026-11-14T15:30), in the house's time zone.

end.name: End
end.description: For an all-day event, the last day; for a timed event, when it ends. Without it: one day, or one hour.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Says a message on Lena's displays with Home Assistant's own announcement (assist_satellite.announce), by room name; with Listen for an answer, starts a conversation there.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena displays to say it on. Leave empty for all of them.

listen.name: Listen for an answer
listen.description: After saying it, she listens, and answers what you say back.

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name: says it on that room's displays.

tidy_memory.name: Tidy memory
tidy_memory.description: Lena tidies her memory now: she combines lines about the same thing, makes vague ones clear and retires (ticks off) outdated ones, using Home Assistant's AI Task. She also does this on her own; see Configure.

undo_memory_tidy.name: Undo memory tidy
undo_memory_tidy.description: Puts her memory back as it was before her last tidy.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Starts one of Home Assistant's own timers on a Lena display (its Assist satellite).

label.name: Name
label.description: What it is for, e.g. pasta.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: An alarm on a Lena display at the next time the clock shows that time.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

set_reminder.name: Set reminder
set_reminder.description: Lena says a reminder on a display at a time or after a while.

at.name: At
at.description: HH:MM, or a date and time.

in_seconds.name: In seconds
in_seconds.description: Or how many seconds from now.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timer
cancel_timer.description: Cancels timers (Home Assistant's own, on that display), alarms or reminders.

all.name: All
all.description: Cancel all of them (of that kind).

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: One of Home Assistant's timers, by its id (what the Lena app sends when you cancel one there).

list_timers.name: List timers
list_timers.description: What timers, alarms and reminders are set on the displays.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

set_volume.name: Set volume
set_volume.description: How loudly Lena speaks on a display.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena display (the one asked through).

room.name: Room
room.description: A room's name; its display is used instead.

update_fact.name: Update memory
update_fact.description: Corrects one of her memories in place.

old.name: Memory
old.description: The memory to change, in a few words.

history.name: House history
history.description: When something last happened, how long it lasted, or what happened today, from Home Assistant's history.

state.name: State
state.description: The state asked about, e.g. open.
